title: Integrating Armis with Zero Trust Branch

blocks.text: Zscaler Zero Trust Branch integrates with Armis to enable bidirectional data integration. With this integration:

blocks.item: Armis ingests Zero Trust Branch device posture and policy data to enhance visibility of connected assets.
Zero Trust Branch ingests Armis device intelligence (e.g., classification, tags, and risk insights) to strengthen policy enforcement and access control.
Security teams can correlate network enforcement from Zero Trust Branch with device context from Armis, improving zero trust outcomes.

blocks.text: For complete details on working in the Armis management console, refer to your Armis management console documentation.

blocks.heading: Configuring Zero Trust Branch for Armis Integration

blocks.text: Follow these steps to configure the integration between Zero Trust Branch and Armis:

blocks.item: Step 1: Configure the Zero Trust Branch-to-Armis integration
Create an API key in Zero Trust Branch:
From the navigation menu, go to Administration > API > Zero Trust Branch API Keys. Click Settings in the API Keys drawer and select Add API Key from the drop-down menu.
See image.
In the Add API Key drawer, enter a descriptive name and click Add API Key.
See image.
The API key displays. Click the Copy icon to copy and save the API key. You need this key to complete your integration.
See image.
After you close the Add API Key drawer, you are no longer able to view or copy the key.
In the Armis management console, click the Settings icon and select Medical Device Security Settings.
See image.
On the Integrations page, click Add Integration.
See image.
Enter Airgap in the Library search box. In the resulting Airgap panel, click Connect.
See image.
In the Connect Airgap Integration panel:
Instance Name: Enter a unique name for this connection.

Host: Enter the host name of your Zero Trust Branch tenant in the form https://<ztbtenant>-api.goairgap.com. For example, if your tenant is https://myztbtenant.goairgap.com/, enter https://myztbtenant-api.goairgap.com.
API Key: Enter the key you saved in step 1c previously.
Click Test Connection to verify that the connection is successful.
See image.
Click Connect to save the integration.
See image.
On the Integrations page, verify that the new integration status is Active. Click Run Now if you want to begin the integration now.
See image.
Step 2: Configure the Armis-to-Zero Trust Branch integration
In the Armis management console, go to API Management and click Show.
See image.
Copy the API secret key from the pop-up window and click OK.
See image.
In the Zscaler Admin Console, go to Zero Trust Branch > Resources > Integrations. Click Settings in the Armis Integration panel.
See image.
In the Armis Integration drawer:
Server URL: Enter the URL of the Armis management console.
Authentication Method: The API KEY authentication method is filled in automatically.
Authentication Key: Enter the API secret key you copied in step 2.
Description: Optionally, add a description for this integration.
Click Test to verify the connection, then click Save to finalize the integration.
See image.
Step 3: Verify the integration

blocks.text: To verify integration in the Zscaler Admin Console:

blocks.item: Go to Zero Trust Branch > Dashboard > Asset Intelligence. Click an asset and verify that the tags from Armis are displayed in the Tags section of the asset profile.
See image.
Click the Armis tab to view additional data for that asset from Armis.
See image.
Data from Armis is only synced for assets that have already been discovered.
In the Armis management console, go to Assets. Click any asset to view its details.
See image.
On the Overview tab for the asset, verify that it has the airgap:protected tag.
See image.
